```{r setup}
library(BPCells)
library(tidyverse)
library(sccomp)
library(readxl)
set.seed(1)

#clean animal metadata
animal_metadata = readr::read_csv("../shared objs and code/mouse_meta.csv")
animal_metadata$ID = as.character(animal_metadata$ID)
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% dplyr::select("ID", "Sex", "Line.short", "Genotype", "Age (months)") %>% dplyr::rename("age" = "Age (months)","strain" = "Line.short", "sex" = "Sex", "genotype" = "Genotype", "animal_id" = "ID")
#load animal phenotype data
animal_phenotype_data = read.csv("../shared objs and code/YM_CFC_BW_SM_calo_AB_individual_data_cleaned_20240826.csv")
animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice = animal_phenotype_data %>% filter(ID %in% animal_metadata$animal_id)
#add age of death, then filter behavioral metadata for this timepoint, since some mice were phenotyped more than just prior to death. But our analysis will focus on the data collected from the timepoint prior to death. 

animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$age_at_death = animal_metadata$age[match(animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$ID, animal_metadata$animal_id)]
animal_phenotype_data_at_death = animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice %>% filter(age_at_death == AgeGrp)


#add CFA and CFM (cognitive metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$CFA = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFC.PS4[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]
animal_metadata$CFM = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFM.Total[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]


#add Weight (metabolic/physical metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$Weight = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$Weight[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]
#z score continuous variables (Weight, CFA, CFM)
animal_metadata <- animal_metadata %>%
  mutate(across(c(Weight, CFA, CFM), ~ scale(.x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)[, 1]))

#change age_at_death to "young" for 6 and "old" for 14
animal_metadata$age = case_when(
  animal_metadata$age == "6" ~ "young",
  animal_metadata$age == "14" ~ "old",
  .default = NA
)

#load neuronal + non-neuronal assignments
non_neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/non_neuronal_assignments.rds")
neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/neuronal_number_ids_cluster_assignments.rds")
neuronal_names  = names(neuronal_cluster_assignments)
#append neuronal to show the class
neuronal_cluster_assignments = paste0("neuronal-",neuronal_cluster_assignments)
names(neuronal_cluster_assignments) = neuronal_names
cluster_assignments = c(non_neuronal_cluster_assignments, neuronal_cluster_assignments)

#create df with cell id and cluster for each cell
cell_metadata = data.frame(cell_id = names(cluster_assignments), cluster = cluster_assignments)
#get animal id from name of cell ()
cell_metadata$animal_id = gsub(".*_(\\d+)-.*", "\\1", cell_metadata$cell_id)
#join cell metadata with animal metadata by animal_id
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% left_join(animal_metadata, by = "animal_id")

#Remove the single animal w/o CFC/CFA measurements (could be potential confound)
animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm = animal_metadata %>% filter(is.na(CFM) | is.na(CFA)) %>% pull(animal_id) %>% unique %>% as.character
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm)

#identify animals with less than 1000 cells and remove them from dataset (low number of cells for an animal may throw off proportions)
animals_less_1000_cells = cell_metadata$animal_id %>% table %>% .[. < 1000] %>% names
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animals_less_1000_cells)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animals_less_1000_cells)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% droplevels()

#remove tcells since only one cluster
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(cluster != "tcells")

# Split  on cell class
cell_metadata$cell_class <- sub("[-_].*", "", cell_metadata$cluster)

#Identify classes with only one cluster (remove from proportion analysis)
classes_one_cluster = cell_metadata %>% ungroup() %>% distinct(cluster, cell_class) %>% ungroup() %>% count(cell_class) %>% filter(n == 1) %>% pull(cell_class)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!cell_class %in% classes_one_cluster) %>% droplevels()
# Split the cluster assignments into a list by cell class
cluster_list <- split(cell_metadata, cell_metadata$cell_class)

#convert animal_id to factor, to use to add metadata later 
animal_metadata$animal_id = as.factor(animal_metadata$animal_id)

```


Get list of cluster counts per cell class
```{r}
cluster_counts_per_class = vector(mode = "list", length = length(cluster_list))
names(cluster_counts_per_class) = names(cluster_list)

for(i in seq_along(cluster_list)) {
  cur_class = names(cluster_list)[i]
  #initialize df to count cluster counts
  cluster_counts = cluster_list[[cur_class]] %>% ungroup()
  #convert columns to factor
  cluster_counts$cluster = as.factor(cluster_counts$cluster)
  cluster_counts$animal_id = as.factor(cluster_counts$animal_id)
  cluster_counts$age = as.factor(cluster_counts$age)
  cluster_counts = cluster_counts %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(cluster, animal_id, .drop = F) %>% dplyr::count(name = "count")
  #add other columns back
  cluster_counts = cluster_counts %>% left_join(animal_metadata, by = "animal_id")
  #convert columns to factor
  cluster_counts$genotype = as.factor(cluster_counts$genotype)
  cluster_counts$strain = as.factor(cluster_counts$strain)
  cluster_counts$sex = as.factor(cluster_counts$sex)
  cluster_counts$age = as.factor(cluster_counts$age)
  #add "animal_" and "cluster_" to relevant columns to avoid problems with sccomp
  cluster_counts$animal_id = paste0("animal_", cluster_counts$animal_id) %>% as.factor()
  cluster_counts$cluster = paste0("cluster_", cluster_counts$cluster) %>% as.factor()
  #relevel to get the following as reference: genotype - Ntg, age - 6, sex - M
  cluster_counts$genotype = relevel(cluster_counts$genotype, ref = "Ntg")
  cluster_counts$age = relevel(cluster_counts$age, ref = "young")
  cluster_counts$sex = relevel(cluster_counts$sex, ref = "Male")
  cluster_counts = cluster_counts %>%
    mutate(age_genotype = interaction(age, genotype,sep = "_"))
  cluster_counts$strain = relevel(cluster_counts$strain, ref = "B6")
  #ungroup the data to avoid problems with sccomp
  cluster_counts = cluster_counts %>% ungroup()
  cluster_counts_per_class[[cur_class]] = cluster_counts
}


# Add "animal_" prefix to animal_id for filtering
animal_metadata$animal_id = paste0("animal_", animal_metadata$animal_id) %>% as.factor()

```


```{r}
sccomp_class_results_list = list()
# Loop through each cell class
for(i in seq_along(cluster_counts_per_class)) {
  cur_class = names(cluster_counts_per_class)[i]
  cluster_counts = cluster_counts_per_class[[cur_class]]
  

  # Run sccomp analysis
  model = cluster_counts %>%
    sccomp_estimate(
      formula_composition = "~strain + sex + age + genotype" %>% as.formula(),
      sample = "animal_id",
      cell_group = "cluster",
      abundance = "count",
      bimodal_mean_variability_association = T
    ) 
  model = model %>% sccomp_remove_outliers(percent_false_positive = 10)
  contrast_result = model %>% sccomp_test(test_composition_above_logit_fold_change = 0)
  contrast_result$class = cur_class
  contrast_result = contrast_result %>% filter(grepl("strain",parameter))
  # Store the combined model results
  sccomp_class_results_list[[cur_class]] = contrast_result
}

# Save the results
sccomp_results <- bind_rows(sccomp_class_results_list)
saveRDS(sccomp_results, "sccomp_results_strain.rds")
```


voom clr results
```{r}
library(voomCLR)
voomclr_formula = as.formula("~strain + sex + age + genotype") #account for 1|strain using duplicateCorrelation

# Loop through each cell class
voomclr_list_res = list()

for(cur_class in (sccomp_class_results_list %>% names)) {
  cluster_counts = cluster_counts_per_class[[cur_class]]
  
  #celltype = rows
  #sample = cols
  cluster_counts_voomclr = cluster_counts %>%
    select(cluster, animal_id, count) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = animal_id, values_from = count, values_fill = NA) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "cluster")
  #create design mat based on formula
  cluster_counts_voomclr_meta = cluster_counts %>% distinct(animal_id, .keep_all = T) %>% select(-cluster, -count)
  cluster_counts_voomclr_meta = cluster_counts_voomclr_meta[match(colnames(cluster_counts_voomclr),cluster_counts$animal_id), ]
  design_mat = model.matrix(voomclr_formula, data = cluster_counts_voomclr_meta)
  #make names valid
  colnames(design_mat) = make.names(colnames(design_mat))
  # Run voomCLR analysis
  model <- voomCLR(
    cluster_counts_voomclr, 
    design = design_mat,
    varCalc	 = "analytical"
  )
  fit <- lmFit(model, design_mat)
  
  fit_results <- eBayes(fit)
  strain_coefs = fit_results$coefficients %>% colnames %>% .[grepl("strain",.)]
  results_list_per_strain = list()
  for(j in 1:length(strain_coefs)) {
    cur_coef = strain_coefs[j]
    cur_strain_relative_to_b6_results = topTableBC(fit_results, coef =cur_coef, n = Inf,adjust.method = "none")
    cur_strain_relative_to_b6_results = cur_strain_relative_to_b6_results %>% rownames_to_column("cluster")
    cur_strain_relative_to_b6_results$strain = cur_coef
    results_list_per_strain[[cur_coef]] = cur_strain_relative_to_b6_results
  }
  full_results_df = results_list_per_strain %>% bind_rows
  full_results_df$class = cur_class
  voomclr_list_res[[cur_class]] = full_results_df
}

voomclr_results_df = do.call(rbind, voomclr_list_res)

#adj p val
voomclr_results_df = voomclr_results_df %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  mutate(adj.P.Val = p.adjust(P.Value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

saveRDS(voomclr_results_df, "voomclr_results_strain.rds")
```


```{r}
library(ANCOMBC)
library(TreeSummarizedExperiment)

#run through each class and perform contrasts
final_ancombc_results = list()
for (class_name in names(cluster_counts_per_class)) {
  message(paste0("Processing Class: ", class_name))
  df_curr = cluster_counts_per_class[[class_name]]
  #create TSE/treesummarizedexperiment class
  #pivot counts to wide format: Rows = Clusters, Cols = Animals
  count_mat = df_curr %>% 
    dplyr::select(cluster, animal_id, count) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = animal_id, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("cluster") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  meta_df = df_curr %>% 
    distinct(animal_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("animal_id")
  
  meta_df = meta_df[colnames(count_mat), ]
  tse = TreeSummarizedExperiment::TreeSummarizedExperiment(
    assays = list(counts = count_mat),
    colData = meta_df
  )
  
    # p_adj_method = "none" 
    out = ancombc2(
      data = tse,
      assay_name = "counts",
      fix_formula = "strain + age + sex + genotype",
      p_adj_method = "none", 
      n_cl = 8,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    
    res_table = out$res %>%
    dplyr::select(taxon, dplyr::matches("^(lfc|se|p)_strain")) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -taxon,
      names_to = c("stat", "contrast"),
      names_pattern = "^(lfc|se|p)_strain(.+)$"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>%
    dplyr::rename(cluster = taxon, p_val = p) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(class = class_name)
    

  final_ancombc_results[[class_name]] = res_table
}

# Combine all results into a single dataframe
ancombc_results_df = bind_rows(final_ancombc_results)

#p val correction for each class 
ancombc_results_df = ancombc_results_df %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  mutate(p_val_adj = p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

saveRDS(ancombc_results_df, "ancombc2_prop_results.rds")
```

#to reproduce figure, can rerun intro chunk then from here on (using run statistical models from ancombc2, sccomp, voomclr)
```{r}
ancombc_results_df = readRDS("ancombc2_prop_results.rds")
sccomp_results = readRDS("sccomp_results_strain.rds")
voomclr_results_df = readRDS("voomclr_results_strain.rds")

#threshold set at .1 in 2 of 3 methods
FDR_CUT = 0.1

norm_key       = function(x) make.names(as.character(x))
clean_contrast = function(x) make.names(stringr::str_remove(as.character(x), "^strain"))

sccomp_std = sccomp_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("^strain", parameter)) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(cell_class = class,
                   cluster_key = norm_key(cluster),
                   contrast = clean_contrast(parameter),
                   estimate = c_effect, fdr = c_FDR, method = "sccomp")

voomclr_std = voomclr_results_df %>%
  dplyr::transmute(cell_class = class,
                   cluster_key = norm_key(cluster),
                   contrast = clean_contrast(strain),
                   estimate = logFC, fdr = adj.P.Val, method = "voomCLR")

ancombc_std = ancombc_results_df %>%
  dplyr::transmute(cell_class = class,
                   cluster_key = norm_key(cluster),
                   contrast = clean_contrast(contrast),
                   estimate = lfc, fdr = p_val_adj, method = "ancombc2")

all_res = bind_rows(sccomp_std, voomclr_std, ancombc_std) %>%
  mutate(dir = sign(estimate),
         sig = !is.na(fdr) & fdr < FDR_CUT & dir != 0)

#contrast = strain here (comparing a given strain to B6)
consensus = all_res %>%
  mutate(sig_up     = sig & dir > 0,
         sig_down   = sig & dir < 0,
         sig_method = if_else(sig, method, NA)) %>%
  group_by(cell_class, cluster_key, contrast) %>%
  summarise(n_sig_up      = sum(sig_up),
            n_sig_down    = sum(sig_down),
            n_agree       = max(n_sig_up, n_sig_down),
            consensus_dir = if_else(n_sig_up > n_sig_down, "up", "down"),
            methods_sig   = str_flatten(sig_method, collapse = " + ", na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_agree >= 2)
#simplify with str_flatten

# per-method effects/FDRs + original (unmangled) cluster label for readability
cluster_lookup = sccomp_results %>%
  distinct(cluster) %>%
  transmute(cluster_key = norm_key(cluster), cluster = as.character(cluster))

# one row per cluster x strain, with each method's estimate and FDR side by side
method_results_wide = all_res %>%
  select(cell_class, cluster_key, contrast, method, estimate, fdr) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = c(estimate, fdr))

consensus_hits = consensus %>%
  left_join(method_results_wide, by = c("cell_class", "cluster_key", "contrast")) %>%
  left_join(cluster_lookup, by = "cluster_key") %>%
  select(-cluster_key) %>%
  relocate(cell_class, cluster, contrast) %>%
  arrange(cell_class, contrast, desc(n_agree), cluster)


saveRDS(consensus_hits, "consensus_strain_hits.rds")
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)
df_internal_and_official_name = read_csv("../shared objs and code/internal_to_official_name_conversions_neuronal.csv")

# --- 1. fill = sccomp effect; star = consensus criterion ---
plot_data <- sccomp_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("^strain", parameter)) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    cell_class  = class,
    cluster     = as.character(cluster),
    c_effect,
    strain      = gsub("^strain", "", parameter),   
    contrast    = clean_contrast(parameter),        
    cluster_key = norm_key(cluster)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    consensus_hits %>%
      dplyr::transmute(cell_class, contrast,
                       cluster_key = norm_key(cluster),
                       consensus_dir, n_agree, methods_sig),
    by = c("cell_class", "contrast", "cluster_key")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(is_significant = !is.na(consensus_dir))

# --- 2. relabel clusters, order classes with neuronal last ---
plot_data_heatmap <- plot_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cluster = dplyr::if_else(cell_class == "neuronal",
                                         sub("^cluster_neuronal-", "", cluster),
                                         sub("^cluster_", "", cluster))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    official = df_internal_and_official_name$official_name[
      match(cluster, as.character(df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id))],
    cluster  = dplyr::if_else(cell_class == "neuronal",
                              dplyr::coalesce(official, cluster), cluster)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-official) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cell_class = factor(cell_class, levels = c(
    sort(setdiff(unique(.$cell_class), "neuronal")), "neuronal"))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cell_class, cluster) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = unique(.$cluster)))

plot_data_non_neuronal <- plot_data_heatmap %>%
  dplyr::filter(cell_class != "neuronal") %>% droplevels()
plot_data_neuronal <- plot_data_heatmap %>%
  dplyr::filter(cell_class == "neuronal") %>% droplevels()

max_abs_effect <- max(abs(plot_data_heatmap$c_effect), na.rm = TRUE)
color_limits   <- c(-max_abs_effect, max_abs_effect)
```


```{r}
# --- 3. one builder, two panels ---
make_panel <- function(df, title, ylab) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = strain, y = cluster, fill = c_effect)) +
    geom_tile(color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, is_significant),
              label = "*", color = "black", size = 6, vjust = 0.75) +
    facet_grid(cell_class ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(name = "Logit-fold change (sccomp)",
                         low = "#0571b0", mid = "white", high = "#ca0020",
                         midpoint = 0, limits = color_limits) +
    labs(title = title, y = ylab, x = "Strain (vs. B6)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
      strip.text.y.left = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 0),
      panel.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "lines"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.title.position = "plot"
    )
}

combined_plot <-
  (make_panel(plot_data_non_neuronal, "Non-Neuronal Clusters", "Cluster") +
   make_panel(plot_data_neuronal,     "Neuronal Clusters",     "")) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(caption = paste0(
    "* = consistent direction and FDR < ", FDR_CUT,
    " in \u2265 2 of 3 methods (sccomp, voomCLR, ANCOM-BC2). Fill shows the sccomp estimate.")) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("consensus_strain_comparisons_vs_b6.pdf", combined_plot, width = 18, height = 20)
```
